fields.quoted_span: Foreclosure alone is not grounds for eviction in New Jersey.
fields.note: Most of the requirement matches the Foreclosure section: the 90-day notice to quit, the longer-lease rule, the English and Spanish notice within 10 business days, posting in buildings with more than 10 units, the court-rule notice for foreclosing creditors, and the separate notice for buyout offers with the five-day review period and the pressure-tactics ban. Two details are off. The guide ties the 90-day notice to a buyer who wants to personally occupy the property as a primary residence, and the rule's wording on this is loose. The guide also says month-to-month tenants are not exempt from the notice. The rule says a tenant whose lease runs longer cannot be evicted until it expires; the guide adds that the 90-day notice must still be given, which the rule omits.

fields.quoted_span: within 10 business days after the sale, letting tenants know that ownership has changed hands
fields.note: The 90-day notice to quit appears in the Foreclosure section ("90 -day notice to qui t"). The English and Spanish notice within 10 business days and the five-day review period for buyout offers both appear in the guide. The key_value matches.
The rule's effective_date is empty and the guide states no effective date for the Foreclosure Fairness Act provisions.

fields.quoted_span: Any person acquiring a foreclosed property containing one or more residential rental units must provide notices to the tenants in English and Spanish
fields.note: The guide presents these requirements in the present tense as current obligations, which is consistent with in_force. It states no explicit status or repeal information.

fields.quoted_span:
Month-
to-month tenants and two- and three-family owner-occupied units are not exempt from the 90-day notice requirements.
fields.note: The guide supports min_units of 1 ("one or more residential rental units"). It also supports the foreclosed-property condition and the point that owner-occupied two- and three-family units are not exempt from the 90-day notice.
The guide cites N.J.S.A. 2A:50-69 et seq. and names the New Jersey Foreclosure Fairness Act. It also cites 2A:50-70(c)2 and 2A:50-71(b), which fit the listed aliases 2A:50-70 and 2A:50-71.
